login.title: Welcome to Move2Health
login.description: Enter your email below to login to your account

dashboard.yourCustomGoal: Your current fitness goal. Edit it to get a personalized workout plan.
dashboard.setCustomGoal: Describe your fitness goal. Be as specific as you like!

workoutError.message: We couldn't generate a workout for you at this time. Please try again later. Error:

lose_weight.title: Lose Weight
lose_weight.description: This plan focuses on calorie deficit through a combination of cardio and strength training to maximize fat loss while preserving muscle.

gain_muscle.title: Gain Muscle
gain_muscle.description: This plan is designed for muscle hypertrophy with progressive overload in strength training and a protein-rich diet.

maintain_fitness.title: Maintain Fitness
maintain_fitness.description: This plan provides a balanced routine of strength, cardio, and flexibility to maintain your current fitness level and overall health.

logWorkout.title: Log Your Workout
logWorkout.description: Provide feedback to tailor your next session.
logWorkout.feedbackPlaceholder: e.g., 'The cardio was too easy, but the squats were tough.'
logWorkout.nextWorkoutAdjusted: Your next workout will be adjusted based on your feedback.

mealAnalysis.title: Meal Photo Analysis
mealAnalysis.description: Take a picture of your meal and M2H will provide a nutritional breakdown.

progressAnalysis.title: Body Progress Analysis
progressAnalysis.description: Upload a photo to track your fitness journey. M2H will analyze changes and provide feedback.

photoAnalysis.unexpectedError: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

dietPlan.title: Your Daily Diet Plan
dietPlan.description: Get smart meal suggestions throughout your day.
dietPlan.pantryEmptyDescription: Add some ingredients to your pantry to start getting personalized meal suggestions.
dietPlan.mealLoggedDescription: has been added to your daily log.
dietPlan.manualLogDescription: What did you eat? This will be logged and will influence future suggestions.
dietPlan.manualLogDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g., Two eggs, one slice of whole wheat toast

pantry.title: Your Pantry
pantry.description: Manage the ingredients you have at home. Your diet plan will be based on this list.
pantry.itemPlaceholder: e.g., Chicken breast, brown rice, broccoli
pantry.currentItemsDescription: This is what M2H will use to create your meals.

addToPantry.description: Add ingredients by uploading a receipt photo or pasting text.
addToPantry.photoDescription: Take a picture of your shopping receipt.
addToPantry.textDescription: Copy and paste the list of items from a digital receipt or notes.
addToPantry.noInputError: Please provide an image or text to analyze.

addToPantry.noItemsFound: No items could be extracted. Please try again with a clearer image or text.
